articles.title: Quantum-proof blockchain: why math, not machines, holds the key
articles.snippet: lockchains don’t need quantum computers to be quantum-safe, argues Optimum co-founder and MIT professor Muriel Médard. Classic math already gives us the tools.

articles.title: OpenAI IPO won't happen this year, says Sam Altman
articles.snippet: "Given everything happening with safety, right now would be an ill-advised moment to go public," OpenAI CEO Sam Altman told Fortune.

articles.title: Bitcoin Suisse plans to cut up to half its Swiss jobs as it shifts work abroad
articles.snippet: The company is closing its Copenhagen IT site while maintaining Bratislava and opening a new hub in Vietnam to reduce costs.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO calls for AI race to slow down citing safety. Musk and OpenAI's Altman agrees
articles.snippet: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei, OpenAI’s Sam Altman and Elon Musk have agreed on an unusual position: frontier AI development may need to slow as systems become capable of helping build their own successors.

articles.title: Ripple stablecoin chief sees $13 trillion corporate treasury opportunity for RLUSD
articles.snippet: Payments and capital markets are driving growth for Ripple's $2.4 billion digital dollar as it looks to bring RLUSD to Europe under MiCA, the firm's Jack McDonald said.
